title: Request for Information: Audit Support and Remediation Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > USMC > MARCOR SYSCOM > COMMANDER
description:
Marine Corps Systems Command Director of Audit is responsible for Command audit readiness and compliance. In fulfilling this responsibility, the Director of Audit maintains the auditability of the acquisition process through collaboration, process development, process improvement, and the accelerated optimization of Command audit efforts. 

 In support of its responsibility, the Director of Audit is conducting market research to determine industry interest and capability in providing comprehensive audit support and remediation services in support of Marine Corps financial statement audit activities and related financial management reviews. 

 Please see the attachment for additional details.
